2608.24790.title: Right Diagnoses, Decorative Reasoning:A Perturbation Audit of Medical Chain-of-Thought
2608.24790.paper_summary: Clinicians read chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales as evidence of medical reasoning, but whether the visible chain plays that role is rarely tested. General-domain CoT-faithfulness probes ignore clinical cost, and medical LLM evaluations treat the chain as a black box. We close this gap with a medical perturbation audit: a 30-operator battery edits both the chain and the question with clinically motivated operators (severity reversal, negation flip, demographic swap, evidence ablation), paired with a chain-update times answer-flip joint analysis that classifies each model by its failure mode. Applied to 14 LLMs on four medical QA benchmarks, three independent tests converge: the Chain-Decoupling Rate (CDR; chain does not register the edit and the answer does not flip) is 72.9% panel-wide on clinically meaningful destructive edits, chain corruption leaves accuracy unchanged, and removing CoT prompting does not reduce accuracy. Two board-certified clinicians re-annotate N=197 perturbed questions; 98.5% leave the gold defensible. The pattern holds across medical and reasoning fine-tuning and scale; on the closed-source tier, where the chain text is unavailable, the answer-side signals are consistent with the same decoupling. Our framework and CDR provide a reusable yardstick for auditing whether medical CoT is faithful or merely documentation.
2608.24790.paper_summary_zh: 臨床醫生將思考鏈（CoT）推理視為醫學推理的證據，但可見的鏈條是否扮演這一角色卻鮮少受到測試。一般領域的 CoT 忠實性探測忽略了臨床成本，而醫學 LLM 評估則將鏈條視為黑箱。我們通過醫學擾動審計來填補這一空白：一個包含 30 個運算子的電池，使用臨床動機的運算子（嚴重性反轉、否定翻轉、人口統計交換、證據剝奪）編輯鏈條和問題，並配合鏈條更新與答案翻轉的聯合分析，對每個模型按其失敗模式進行分類。應用於四個醫學 QA 基準的 14 個 LLM，三項獨立測試結果一致：鏈條解耦率（CDR；鏈條未註冊編輯且答案未翻轉）在臨床意義重大的破壞性編輯中達到 72.9% 的面板廣泛性，鏈條損壞不改變準確性，且移除 CoT 提示不會降低準確性。兩位獲得董事會認證的臨床醫生重新標註 N=197 個擾動問題；98.5% 的問題保持金標準的可辯護性。這一模式在醫學和推理微調及規模上保持一致；在封閉源層級中，鏈條文本不可用，答案側信號與相同的解耦一致。我們的框架和 CDR 提供了一個可重複使用的標準，用於審計醫學 CoT 是否忠實或僅僅是文檔。
